headline: Premier League today: How to watch Arsenal v Leeds United, TV channels & live stream
body: How will Arsenal and Leeds United fare today? Here is what to know, including kick-off time, TV channels and live stream options Three points is all that separates Arsenal and Leeds United as the Premier League returns after a three-week international break, with the latter one of the surprise packages of the season so far. Unlike Arsenal, Leeds have yet to lose a league game this season. Daniel Farke’s team have earned a reputation for being difficult to beat and have the quality to cause an upset in north London this weekend. Continue reading...
